summary: AIFU Inc. (Nasdaq: AIFU) filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, disclosing a non-binding MOU to acquire Peakleap Ventures Limited, an industrial AI company focused on solid waste recycling and resource recovery. The MOU outlines a strategic transformation from a digital finance platform to a dual-engine business ecosystem of Industrial AI + Digital Finance. Terms such as price/share, implied value, and premium are not disclosed. The acquisition is subject to due diligence, definitive agreements, and regulatory approvals. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Structure is a proposed acquisition via MOU; no certainty of consummation. Watch for definitive agreement execution and regulatory clearance.
